title: Bamboo Grove in Rain
prompt: A dense bamboo grove in rain: tall segmented stalks swaying, a moss-covered stone lantern on a path, fog in the depth. Rain falls; focus racks from close stalks to the lantern.
description: How to build a dense photoreal grove from a few bmesh stalks shared by hundreds of instances, fake rain with looping streak tiles, and pull a shallow-depth-of-field rack focus through overcast haze.

brief.prompt: A dense bamboo grove in rain: tall segmented stalks swaying, a moss-covered stone lantern on a path, fog in the depth. Rain falls; focus racks from close stalks to the lantern.

tags.camera: rack focus, near stalks to lantern

techniques: bmesh segmented stalks with a per-vertex node attribute read by the shader
linked instances coloured by Object Info Random
kit.textured scans with moss mixed on up-facing normals
rain as stacked streak tiles on a sawtooth fall
kit.world gradient plus kit.haze for overcast depth
